about_section.title: About Us
about_section.description: We build AI agent solutions for information and intelligence. Our work is grounded in turning complex data into actionable understanding through specialized agent systems.
about_section.mission_description: We are currently focused on building the best AI agent for geolocation tasks, combining reasoning, multimodal analysis, and domain expertise to deliver reliable intelligence from images and other signals.
about_section.vision_description: Over time, we plan to expand this agent framework into other fields where intelligence and decision quality matter, including areas such as corrective AI for financial markets.

products_section.title: Our Products
products_section.geoseer_description: GeoSeer is a sophisticated platform that uses cutting-edge AI to identify locations from uploaded images. Combining geoestimation models, multi-agent analysis, and reasoning verification, it provides unprecedented accuracy in image-based geolocation.
products_section.geoseer_feature_1: Fine-tuned geoestimation models for precise location detection
products_section.geoseer_feature_2: Multi-agent AI architecture with reverse engineering capabilities
products_section.geoseer_feature_3: Reasoning verification for validated, accurate results
